# The interpreter's half of testdata/spread_operand_once.txtar. `sngl test` on
# none runs the checked IR, which passSpreadOnce never touches, so the
# interpreter binds a spread's computed operand once per statement itself
# (ir.StatementSpreads) and reads each field off that value.

sngl test --platform=none spread.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

-- spread.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

struct Pair {
    x int
    y int
}

component panel node {
    var n = 0
    var got = 0
    var p = Pair{x=3, y=4}
    func next() Pair {
        n = n + 1
        return Pair{x=n, y=n * 100}
    }
    func add(x int, y int) => x + y
    func swap(x int, y int) => Pair{x=y, y=x}
    button #once(text="once", @click {
        got = add(...next())
    })
    button #path(text="path", @click {
        got = add(...p)
    })
    button #nested(text="nested", @click {
        got = add(...swap(...next()))
    })
}

func testOperandOnce(t Test, c panel) {
    c.once.click()
    t.assert(c.got == 101)
    t.assert(c.n == 1)
}

func testPathInPlace(t Test, c panel) {
    c.path.click()
    t.assert(c.got == 7)
}

func testNestedOnce(t Test, c panel) {
    c.nested.click()
    t.assert(c.got == 101)
    t.assert(c.n == 1)
}
